name: workspace-mcp
description: ContextOS MCP Server - programmable interface for workspace context.

tools.name: workspace_read
tools.description: Read any file within the workspace with scope-based protection.

tools.name: workspace_write
tools.description: Write or append content to files with automatic git committing.

tools.name: workspace_search
tools.description: Search across workspace using hybrid vector + deep grep with optional Spatial RAG graph boosting.

tools.name: workspace_context
tools.description: Load all relevant project context (CONTEXT.md, memory, decisions, active tasks) in one batch.

tools.name: workspace_log_decision
tools.description: Structurally log architectural decisions in ADR format with auto-commit.

tools.name: workspace_memory_update
tools.description: Maintain and update project-specific context memory in Markdown format.

tools.name: workspace_daily_update
tools.description: Record daily progress entries to the project's chronological log.

tools.name: workspace_sample
tools.description: Retrieve a workspace pulse snapshot including health score, top trends, and recent changes.

tools.name: workspace_validate
tools.description: Validate workspace files or the entire workspace against schema rules.

tools.name: workspace_lock_acquire
tools.description: Acquire an exclusive file lock for a specific agent to prevent concurrent edits.

tools.name: workspace_lock_release
tools.description: Release a previously acquired file lock for a specific agent.

tools.name: workspace_lock_status
tools.description: Check the current lock status of a file (locked/unlocked and holder).

tools.name: workspace_prune
tools.description: Remove stale index entries and temporary files with optional dry-run mode.

tools.name: workspace_pulse
tools.description: Get workspace health metrics including intelligence queue status and recent changes.

tools.name: workspace_mission
tools.description: Create, list, complete, archive, or activate workspace missions with priority tracking.

tools.name: graph_query
tools.description: Traverse the knowledge graph from a start node with configurable depth, direction, and weight filters.

tools.name: workspace_notify
tools.description: Send, read, or broadcast notifications between agents on topic channels.
